name: Himmelpforten (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Himmelpforten (a saint in a yellow gateway on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Himmelpforten; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Himmelpforten arms — saint in a gateway on blue
